whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bonkers Cafe & Restaurants,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.0★ reviews with over 1,300 patrons in Fraser Road Area, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, signature food menu, aur ambiance gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bonkers

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bonkers Cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Bonkers Cafe & Restaurants, Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu showcase, and your Fraser Road location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
